acceptance: %s fully enclosed is selected in contain mode: given each shape from `shapes` and the ENCLOSING lasso in "contain" mode, expect the selection is exactly that element's id
%s fully enclosed is selected in overlap mode: given each shape from `shapes` and the ENCLOSING lasso in "overlap" mode, expect the selection is exactly that element's id
%s partially touched is not selected in contain mode: given each shape from `shapes` and the TOUCHING lasso in "contain" mode, expect nothing is selected
%s partially touched is selected in overlap mode: given each shape from `shapes` and the TOUCHING lasso in "overlap" mode, expect the selection is exactly that element's id

omitting the mode returns the overlap result: given a 100x100 rectangle at the origin and the TOUCHING path passed straight to getLassoSelectedElementIds without, with "overlap" and with "contain", expect the omitted call equals the overlap call and contains the rectangle id; the contain call returns an empty array
contain mode does not select a container when only its label is enclosed: given a text container and a lasso around the label only, in "contain" mode, expect nothing is selected
overlap mode selects the container when its label is enclosed: given the same container and label lasso in "overlap" mode, expect the selection is exactly the container's id
contain mode selects a frame child when only the child is enclosed: given a frame with one child rectangle and the child-only lasso in "contain" mode, expect the selection is exactly the child's id
contain mode selects only the frame when the whole frame is enclosed: given the same frame and child and the whole-frame lasso in "contain" mode, expect the selection is exactly the frame's id

contain mode selects a frame child protruding from its frame when its visible part is enclosed: given the 200x200 frame, the child sticking out past its right edge and the visible-part lasso, in "contain" mode, expect the selection is exactly the child's id
contain mode does not select a group when one member is not enclosed: given rectA and rectB in group g1 and the ENCLOSING lasso around rectA only, in "contain" mode, expect nothing is selected
overlap mode selects the whole group when one member is enclosed: given the same group and the ENCLOSING lasso, in "overlap" mode, expect the selection is exactly rectA's and rectB's ids
contain mode selects the group when every member is enclosed: given the same group and the whole-group lasso, in "contain" mode, expect the selection is exactly rectA's and rectB's ids

contain mode does not select an element a concave lasso edge cuts across: given the rectangle and the notched lasso whose corners-all-inside edge cuts it, in "contain" mode, expect nothing is selected
overlap mode selects an element a concave lasso edge cuts across: given the same rectangle and notched lasso, in "overlap" mode, expect the selection is exactly the rectangle's id
